edits.intended_fault: R1 (ADJUDICATION_W1; evaluate.evaluate) counts as presenters only the bundles that passed every bundle check (c['nodes'] is empty for a refused bundle), instead of every bundle that presents the node id (c['node_ids']). A node presented by one clean bundle and one REFUSED bundle is then no longer EVIDENCE_DUPLICATE; the second loop resolves it by argument order: clean bundle first -> the node is pooled and evaluated, refused bundle first -> EVIDENCE_REFUSED and UNQUALIFIED. The registered rule is 'no argument-order resolution'. The repair's pin (test_r1_b1_duplicate_node_across_bundles) uses two CLEAN bundles, so the mutant passes it.
